name: Quantum Mechanics
description: Fundamental theory in physics that provides a description of the physical properties of nature at the scale of atoms and subatomic particles.

name: Theory of Relativity
description: Geometric theory of gravitation published by Albert Einstein.

name: Astrophysics
description: Branch of astronomy that employs the principles of physics and chemistry.

name: Particle Physics
description: Branch of physics that studies the nature of the particles that constitute matter and radiation.

name: Statistical Mechanics
description: Mathematical framework that applies statistical methods and probability theory to large assemblies of microscopic entities.
